metric: [per query] Avg tokens spent per query (queries with complete token data)
source: checkpoint repair_attempts (queries/<uid>/<strategy>.json or trials/): sum of total_tokens_delta

metric: [per query] Rounds with no recorded token count
source: checkpoint repair_attempts (queries/<uid>/<strategy>.json or trials/): total_tokens_delta is null

metric: [per query] Avg tokens spent per query - known values only, all queries (lower bound)
source: checkpoint repair_attempts (queries/<uid>/<strategy>.json or trials/): sum of non-null total_tokens_delta; rounds without a count add 0

metric: [per query] Avg repair time per query (s)
source: checkpoint repair_attempts (queries/<uid>/<strategy>.json or trials/): sum of repair_time_seconds

metric: [per query] Efficiency: CS checks fixed per 100k tokens
source: avg CS-check gain per query / avg tokens per query x 100k (queries with token data)

metric: [per query] Efficiency: PC gained per 100k tokens
source: avg PC gain per query / avg tokens per query x 100k (queries with token data)

metric: [per query] Queries with at least one round that changed the plan
source: checkpoint repair_history: candidate verification.translated_plan vs the plan in place before the round; cache = repair_attempt.repair_metadata.llm_cache_hits > 0

metric: [per query] Avg change in PC passed per changed round (loop verifier)
source: checkpoint repair_history: candidate verification.translated_plan vs the plan in place before the round; cache = repair_attempt.repair_metadata.llm_cache_hits > 0; each query's own average, then averaged over queries with a changed round

metric: [per query] Avg change in CS errors per changed round (loop verifier; negative = fewer errors)
source: checkpoint repair_history: candidate verification.translated_plan vs the plan in place before the round; cache = repair_attempt.repair_metadata.llm_cache_hits > 0; each query's own average, then averaged over queries with a changed round

metric: [round-wise] % of rounds where the plan changed
source: checkpoint repair_history: candidate verification.translated_plan vs the plan in place before the round; cache = repair_attempt.repair_metadata.llm_cache_hits > 0

metric: [round-wise] % of rounds unchanged - answered from cache (exact repeat of an earlier request)
